messages:
Isha: Quick heads-up: sample-app onboarding test failed because node sdk coerced tool fn_call output into an array when retry path double-encoded the body. py stayed strict and errored.
Ben: can you paste raw body you saw?
Isha: raw before parse: '"[{\"action\":\"create\"}]"' (quotes + escaped inner JSON) after retry. node helper parsed to [{"action":"create"}] and then normalized, py JSONDecodeError.
Oscar: sounds like retry middleware did JSON.stringify for logging and forwarded that on retry. we had a ticket about that.
Ben: short mitigation: set `sdk.config.jsonMode.strict = true` in sample-app to fail fast. also add small parity CI job comparing node+py parsed shapes.
Isha: agreed. opened issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/524 with stacktrace and mini repro.
ci-bot: created CI run #9091 to run parity matrix against sample-fixture.
ops-bot: infra ticket #infra-812 created to patch retry wrapper (avoid re-stringifying body). ETA 90m.
Oscar: long-term: remove permissive coercion in node by default, expose an opt-in normalizer `sdk.normalizeToolResponse(res, {coerce:true})` and add unit tests for retry paths.
Ben: will draft the PR for node helper revert + opt-in API. tagging @Isha for sample-app PR to pin strict until release.
Isha: thanks — will update README and pin. will unpin after patch lands.
